```{r setup, include=FALSE}
knitr::opts_chunk$set(echo = TRUE, warning = FALSE, message = FALSE,
                      fig.width = 7, fig.height = 4.5, dpi = 300,
                      fig.path = "figure/")
library(readr); library(readxl); library(dplyr); library(tidyr)
library(ggplot2); library(ggpubr); library(patchwork); library(scales)
source("../script/theme_pub.R")
source("../script/utils_stats.R")
# Match by panel prefix: the supplied file names contain double spaces in
# different positions, so hard-coding the full name is fragile.
pick <- function(prefix) {
  f <- list.files(".", pattern = paste0("^", prefix))
  if (length(f) != 1) stop(paste("Expected exactly 1 file starting with", prefix,
                                 "but found", length(f)))
  f
}
read_wide <- function(f) {
  w <- read.csv(f, check.names = FALSE, stringsAsFactors = FALSE)
  pivot_longer(w, cols = -replicate, names_to = "group",
               values_to = "relative_glucose_concentration")
}
```

All source files below are the **original exported tables** deposited in this folder. Knit with `rmarkdown::render('fig2/fig2.Rmd')`; the knitted `fig2.html` is committed alongside.

> Note on significance marks: p-values are recomputed from the deposited replicates. If the published panel used a different test or normalisation, replace the test in the corresponding section; do not overwrite the source values.

## Panel A — KEGG pathway interest size

```{r F2A, fig.cap="A. Interest size (number of related genes) per KEGG pathway."}
d <- read.csv("F2A_pathway_interest_size.csv", fileEncoding = "UTF-8-BOM",
              check.names = FALSE, stringsAsFactors = FALSE)
d <- d[, 1:2]; names(d) <- c("pathway", "genes")
d$n_genes      <- lengths(strsplit(as.character(d$genes), "\\s*,\\s*"))
d$pathway_short <- sub("^map[0-9]+\\s+", "", d$pathway)
print(d[, c("pathway_short", "n_genes")], row.names = FALSE)
ggplot(d, aes(reorder(pathway_short, n_genes), n_genes)) +
  geom_col(fill = "#E86A62", width = 0.7) +
  geom_text(aes(label = n_genes), hjust = -0.25, size = 3.5) +
  coord_flip() + scale_y_continuous(expand = expansion(mult = c(0, 0.12))) +
  labs(x = NULL, y = "Interest size (related genes)") + theme_pub()
```

> The deposited table lists one gene set per pathway; interest size is the number of genes in `Related Genes` (33, 25, 30, 31, 20, 18, 19, 19). If the published panel shows a second (grey) series, deposit that second table and extend this chunk — do not invent values.

## Panel B — propionylation sites per protein

```{r F2B, fig.cap="B. Number of Kpr sites per protein."}
d <- read_csv("F2B_Kpr_sites_per_protein.csv", show_col_types = FALSE)
cnt <- d %>% count(`Gene name`, name = "n_sites") %>% arrange(desc(n_sites))
print(cnt, n = Inf)
p <- ggplot(cnt, aes(reorder(`Gene name`, n_sites), n_sites, fill = n_sites)) +
  geom_col(width = 0.82) + coord_polar(theta = "x") +
  scale_fill_gradient(low = "#F6C6A8", high = "#7B2B6B") +
  labs(x = NULL, y = NULL, fill = "sites") + theme_pub()
print(p)
```

## Panels C–N, Q–T — immunoblots and the PCCA domain map (image only)

Panels C–N, Q–T are reproduced from the **uncropped originals / editable sources** listed in `F2_image_panels_manifest.csv` (`F2C.tif` … `F2T.tif`, `F2Q.ai`) and stored in `raw_images/`. No densitometry or half-life tables were supplied for these panels; if the journal requires them, deposit a CSV per panel and add a plotting chunk here.

```{r F2_images}
knitr::kable(read_csv("F2_image_panels_manifest.csv", show_col_types = FALSE))
```

## Panel O — relative glucose concentration, p300 knockdown

```{r F2O, fig.cap="O. Relative glucose concentration, Ctr/NaP NC vs NaP sip300."}
d <- read_wide(pick("F2O_"))
p <- ggplot(d, aes(group, relative_glucose_concentration, colour = group)) +
  geom_point(position = position_jitter(0.1), size = 2.6) +
  stat_summary(fun = mean, geom = "point", size = 4, shape = 20) +
  stat_summary(fun.data = mean_sd_fun, geom = "errorbar", width = 0.12) +
  labs(x = NULL, y = "Relative glucose concentration", title = "Panel O") +
  theme_pub() + theme(legend.position = "none")
print(p + stat_compare_means(method = "anova", size = 3.5))
anova_tab <- aov(relative_glucose_concentration ~ group, data = d)
print(summary(anova_tab))
```

## Panel P — relative glucose concentration, SIRT1 knockdown

```{r F2P, fig.cap="P. Relative glucose concentration, Ctr/NaP NC vs NaP siSIRT1."}
# v3: the corrected source table now uses the group label NaP_siSIRT1.
d <- read_wide(pick("F2P_"))
p <- ggplot(d, aes(group, relative_glucose_concentration, colour = group)) +
  geom_point(position = position_jitter(0.1), size = 2.6) +
  stat_summary(fun = mean, geom = "point", size = 4, shape = 20) +
  stat_summary(fun.data = mean_sd_fun, geom = "errorbar", width = 0.12) +
  labs(x = NULL, y = "Relative glucose concentration", title = "Panel P") +
  theme_pub() + theme(legend.position = "none")
print(p + stat_compare_means(method = "anova", size = 3.5))
print(summary(aov(relative_glucose_concentration ~ group, data = d)))
```

## Panel U — relative glucose concentration, WT vs K39R

```{r F2U, fig.cap="U. Relative glucose concentration, Flag-PCCA WT vs K39R."}
d <- read_wide(pick("F2U_"))
res <- compare_two(d$relative_glucose_concentration, d$group, method = "t.test")
p <- ggplot(d, aes(group, relative_glucose_concentration, colour = group)) +
  geom_point(position = position_jitter(0.1), size = 2.6) +
  stat_summary(fun = mean, geom = "point", size = 4, shape = 20) +
  stat_summary(fun.data = mean_sd_fun, geom = "errorbar", width = 0.12) +
  labs(x = NULL, y = "Relative glucose concentration",
       title = sprintf("t-test: p = %.4g (%s)", res$p, res$stars)) +
  theme_pub() + theme(legend.position = "none")
print(p)
```
